_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'EARNED VALUE ANALYSIS REPORT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.05.

f01_Budget_at_Completion_BAC.label: Budget at Completion (BAC)
f01_Budget_at_Completion_BAC.guidance: The total approved baseline budget allocated for the complete project scope.

f02_Planned_Value_PV_Current_Reporting_P.label: Planned Value (PV) / Current Reporting Period
f02_Planned_Value_PV_Current_Reporting_P.guidance: The authorized budget assigned to scheduled work for the current reporting period.

f03_Planned_Value_PV_Current_Period_Cumu.label: Planned Value (PV) / Current Period Cumulative
f03_Planned_Value_PV_Current_Period_Cumu.guidance: The cumulative authorized budget planned from project start through current period.

f04_Planned_Value_PV_Past_Period_Cumulat.label: Planned Value (PV) / Past Period Cumulative
f04_Planned_Value_PV_Past_Period_Cumulat.guidance: The cumulative planned value calculated at the close of the previous reporting period.

f05_Earned_Value_EV_Current_Reporting_Pe.label: Earned Value (EV) / Current Reporting Period
f05_Earned_Value_EV_Current_Reporting_Pe.guidance: The budgeted amount for the work actually completed during the current period.

f06_Earned_Value_EV_Current_Period_Cumul.label: Earned Value (EV) / Current Period Cumulative
f06_Earned_Value_EV_Current_Period_Cumul.guidance: The cumulative budgeted amount for all work accomplished from project start to date.

f07_Earned_Value_EV_Past_Period_Cumulati.label: Earned Value (EV) / Past Period Cumulative
f07_Earned_Value_EV_Past_Period_Cumulati.guidance: The cumulative earned value achieved as of the previous reporting period.

f08_Actual_Cost_AC_Current_Reporting_Per.label: Actual Cost (AC) / Current Reporting Period
f08_Actual_Cost_AC_Current_Reporting_Per.guidance: The actual expenditures incurred for work performed during the current period.

f09_Actual_Cost_AC_Current_Period_Cumula.label: Actual Cost (AC) / Current Period Cumulative
f09_Actual_Cost_AC_Current_Period_Cumula.guidance: The cumulative total actual costs incurred from project start through current period.

f10_Actual_Cost_AC_Past_Period_Cumulativ.label: Actual Cost (AC) / Past Period Cumulative
f10_Actual_Cost_AC_Past_Period_Cumulativ.guidance: The cumulative actual costs recorded as of the previous reporting period.

f11_Schedule_Variance_SV_Current_Reporti.label: Schedule Variance (SV) / Current Reporting Period
f11_Schedule_Variance_SV_Current_Reporti.guidance: The schedule performance in financial terms (EV - PV) for the current period.

f12_Schedule_Variance_SV_Current_Period_.label: Schedule Variance (SV) / Current Period Cumulative
f12_Schedule_Variance_SV_Current_Period_.guidance: The cumulative schedule variance (Cumulative EV - Cumulative PV) to date.

f13_Schedule_Variance_SV_Past_Period_Cum.label: Schedule Variance (SV) / Past Period Cumulative
f13_Schedule_Variance_SV_Past_Period_Cum.guidance: The cumulative schedule variance as of the prior reporting period.

f14_Cost_Variance_CV_Current_Reporting_P.label: Cost Variance (CV) / Current Reporting Period
f14_Cost_Variance_CV_Current_Reporting_P.guidance: The financial budget variance (EV - AC) for the current reporting period.

f15_Cost_Variance_CV_Current_Period_Cumu.label: Cost Variance (CV) / Current Period Cumulative
f15_Cost_Variance_CV_Current_Period_Cumu.guidance: The cumulative cost variance (Cumulative EV - Cumulative AC) to date.

f16_Cost_Variance_CV_Past_Period_Cumulat.label: Cost Variance (CV) / Past Period Cumulative
f16_Cost_Variance_CV_Past_Period_Cumulat.guidance: The cumulative cost variance as of the prior reporting period.

f17_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Curre.label: Schedule Performance Index (SPI) / Current Reporting Period
f17_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Curre.guidance: The schedule efficiency ratio (EV / PV) for the current period.

f18_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Curre.label: Schedule Performance Index (SPI) / Current Period Cumulative
f18_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Curre.guidance: The cumulative schedule efficiency ratio (Cumulative EV / Cumulative PV).

f19_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Past_.label: Schedule Performance Index (SPI) / Past Period Cumulative
f19_Schedule_Performance_Index_SPI_Past_.guidance: The cumulative schedule efficiency index from the previous reporting period.

f20_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Current_R.label: Cost Performance Index (CPI) / Current Reporting Period
f20_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Current_R.guidance: The cost efficiency ratio (EV / AC) for the current period.

f21_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Current_P.label: Cost Performance Index (CPI) / Current Period Cumulative
f21_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Current_P.guidance: The cumulative cost efficiency ratio (Cumulative EV / Cumulative AC).

f22_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Past_Peri.label: Cost Performance Index (CPI) / Past Period Cumulative
f22_Cost_Performance_Index_CPI_Past_Peri.guidance: The cumulative cost efficiency index from the previous reporting period.

f23_Percent_Planned_Current_Reporting_Pe.label: Percent Planned / Current Reporting Period
f23_Percent_Planned_Current_Reporting_Pe.guidance: Planned Value divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

f24_Percent_Planned_Current_Period_Cumul.label: Percent Planned / Current Period Cumulative
f24_Percent_Planned_Current_Period_Cumul.guidance: Cumulative Planned Value divided by BAC to measure scheduled completion percentage.

f25_Percent_Planned_Past_Period_Cumulati.label: Percent Planned / Past Period Cumulative
f25_Percent_Planned_Past_Period_Cumulati.guidance: Cumulative Planned Value divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

f26_Percent_Earned_Current_Reporting_Per.label: Percent Earned / Current Reporting Period
f26_Percent_Earned_Current_Reporting_Per.guidance: Earned Value divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

f27_Percent_Earned_Current_Period_Cumula.label: Percent Earned / Current Period Cumulative
f27_Percent_Earned_Current_Period_Cumula.guidance: Cumulative Earned Value divided by BAC representing actual project percent complete.

f28_Percent_Earned_Past_Period_Cumulativ.label: Percent Earned / Past Period Cumulative
f28_Percent_Earned_Past_Period_Cumulativ.guidance: Cumulative Earned Value divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

f29_Percent_Spent_Current_Reporting_Peri.label: Percent Spent / Current Reporting Period
f29_Percent_Spent_Current_Reporting_Peri.guidance: Actual Cost divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

f30_Percent_Spent_Current_Period_Cumulat.label: Percent Spent / Current Period Cumulative
f30_Percent_Spent_Current_Period_Cumulat.guidance: Cumulative Actual Cost divided by BAC representing total project budget spent to date.

f31_Percent_Spent_Past_Period_Cumulative.label: Percent Spent / Past Period Cumulative
f31_Percent_Spent_Past_Period_Cumulative.guidance: Cumulative Actual Cost divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

f32_EAC_w_CPI_Current_Reporting_Period.label: EAC w/CPI / Current Reporting Period
f32_EAC_w_CPI_Current_Reporting_Period.guidance: Estimate at Completion assuming future work performed at current period CPI (BAC / CPI).

f33_EAC_w_CPI_Current_Period_Cumulative.label: EAC w/CPI / Current Period Cumulative
f33_EAC_w_CPI_Current_Period_Cumulative.guidance: Estimate at Completion assuming future work performed at cumulative CPI.

f34_EAC_w_CPI_Past_Period_Cumulative.label: EAC w/CPI / Past Period Cumulative
f34_EAC_w_CPI_Past_Period_Cumulative.guidance: Estimate at Completion based on past period cumulative CPI.

f35_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Current_Reporting_Peri.label: EAC w/CPI × SPI / Current Reporting Period
f35_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Current_Reporting_Peri.guidance: Estimate at Completion factoring both cost and schedule indices for current period.

f36_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Current_Period_Cumulat.label: EAC w/CPI × SPI / Current Period Cumulative
f36_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Current_Period_Cumulat.guidance: Estimate at Completion factoring cumulative cost and schedule performance indices.

f37_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Past_Period_Cumulative.label: EAC w/CPI × SPI / Past Period Cumulative
f37_EAC_w_CPI_SPI_Past_Period_Cumulative.guidance: Estimate at Completion factoring past period cumulative cost and schedule indices.

f38_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_C.label: To Complete Performance Index (TCPI) / Current Reporting Period
f38_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_C.guidance: Cost efficiency required to complete the remaining work within BAC for current period.

f39_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_C.label: To Complete Performance Index (TCPI) / Current Period Cumulative
f39_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_C.guidance: Cost efficiency required to complete the remaining work within BAC cumulatively.

f40_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_P.label: To Complete Performance Index (TCPI) / Past Period Cumulative
f40_To_Complete_Performance_Index_TCPI_P.guidance: TCPI calculated at the close of the prior reporting period.

f41_Selected_EAC_Justification_and_Expla.label: Selected EAC - Justification and Explanation
f41_Selected_EAC_Justification_and_Expla.guidance: Detailed justification of the selected EAC forecasting formula and expected final budget outcome.

f42_Root_cause_of_schedule_variance.label: Root cause of schedule variance
f42_Root_cause_of_schedule_variance.guidance: Underlying drivers and operational causes for schedule efficiency or delay.

f43_Schedule_impact_incl_implications_of.label: Schedule impact (incl. implications of continued variance)
f43_Schedule_impact_incl_implications_of.guidance: Projected delivery delays and critical path impacts if schedule trends continue.

f44_Root_cause_of_cost_variance.label: Root cause of cost variance
f44_Root_cause_of_cost_variance.guidance: Operational factors, rate fluctuations, or scope drivers causing cost variances.

f45_Budget_impact_incl_intended_actions_.label: Budget impact (incl. intended actions/reserves)
f45_Budget_impact_incl_intended_actions_.guidance: Financial exposure and reserve utilization strategies to maintain fiscal control.

f46_Comments.label: Comments
f46_Comments.guidance: Additional contextual observations or recommendations from the EVM analyst.
